# MISS — Dist “Locked:” opener (2026-09-20)

**A friend would hear:** Our replies sounded like a robot stamping “got it” instead of talking.

## Defect
CoS drafts for Dist backlog all started with `Locked:` — ack/stamp voice, not conversation.

## Law
Ban Dist reply openers: Locked / Got it / Copy that / Noted / Ack.
Write like a reply in the thread: engage → lock the point in plain words → one next beat.

## Fix
dist-0xrayai-publish skill · Dist draft law · herald refuse stamp openers.
